description:
Add one post-call action to the agent. The agent's other actions are not changed. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make a retry safe: the same key and body return the action the first request added.
(Tags: Agents)

Idempotency-Key.description: Any unique string. A retry with the same key and body adds nothing new.

allOf.description:
One post-call action. `type` picks the channel; send the fields of
that channel plus any of the shared ones. `type` is required when
adding an action; an update sends only the fields it changes.

channel_id.description: `slack` only: the channel id. Send this or `channel_name`.

channel_name.description: `slack` only: the channel name. Send this or `channel_id`.

create_call_log.description: `zoho_bigin` only: log the call in Zoho Bigin. Defaults to true.

create_contact.description: `zoho_bigin` only: create a contact when no contact matches. Defaults to true.

extracted_variables.description:
Variables the model should pull out of the conversation. A key
already used by another action on this agent must have the same
prompt, or the request is refused with `400`. Other actions are
never changed to match.

key.description: Unique identifier for the variable in the post-call payload.

prompt.description: Instruction for the model on what to pull out of the conversation.
prompt.example: Identify the main issue the customer is experiencing.

integration_id.description:
`google_sheets`, `slack`, `salesforce`, `hubspot`, `zoho_bigin`
only, required: the id of your integration of that type.

object_name.description:
`salesforce`: `Lead` (default), `Contact`, `Account`,
`Opportunity`, `Case`, `Task` or `Product`. `hubspot`, required:
`contact`, `company`, `deal` or `ticket`. Both send a fixed set of
fields for the chosen object, so they take no `extracted_variables`.

phone_number_id.description: `cloud_whatsapp` only, required: your Cloud WhatsApp number the message is sent from. Also send `template_id` or `templates`, or nothing is sent.

recipients.description: `email` only, required: the addresses to notify.

spreadsheet_id.description:
`google_sheets` only, required: the id in the sheet's URL, the
part after `/d/`.

spreadsheet_name.description: `google_sheets` only: the sheet's name, for display.

template_id.description: `cloud_whatsapp` only: an approved template on that number.

template_variables.description: `cloud_whatsapp` only: which extracted variable fills each template placeholder.

extracted_var.description: The key of the extracted variable whose value fills this placeholder.

index.description: The placeholder number, as a string.

templates.description: `cloud_whatsapp` only: one or more templates to send.

items.description: One Cloud WhatsApp template to send after the call.

always_send.description: Send this template after every call, whichever templates the model chooses.

template_id.description: An approved template on the chosen number.

usage_description.description:
When this template should be sent. After the call, the model reads
these descriptions to choose which templates fit the conversation.
usage_description.example: Send when the caller books an appointment.

variable_mappings.description: How to fill each template placeholder.

extracted_var.description: The extracted variable whose value fills this placeholder.

fallback_value.description: The value to use when the variable is not extracted.

index.description: The placeholder number, as a string.

mode.description:
Which input the dashboard shows for this placeholder. It
does not change the value sent: a `static_value` is used
first, then the extracted variable, then `fallback_value`.

static_value.description:
A fixed value for this placeholder. When set, it is used
instead of the extracted variable.

trigger_call_statuses.description:
Call outcomes that fire this action. Omit to use the default
(`completed`, `voicemail_detected`).

type.description:
The channel. It cannot change after the action is created:
delete it and add a new one. `google_sheets`, `slack`,
`salesforce`, `hubspot` and `zoho_bigin` deliver through an
account connected in the dashboard: pass its id as
`integration_id` (see List integrations).

update_contact.description: `zoho_bigin` only: update a matching contact with what the call captured. Defaults to true.

url.description: `webhook` only, required: the endpoint that receives a POST with the call payload.

workflow_id.description: `workflow` only, required: the workflow to run. It must have a published version, or the action is skipped.

worksheet_name.description: `google_sheets` only: the tab to append to. Defaults to `Sheet1`.

name: addPostCallAction
